explain: Known security flaws in the images your containers run. A scan reads an image's package list without starting it, then asks a public database (OSV) about package names and versions only; nothing else leaves the node. It covers Debian, Ubuntu and Alpine images.
off: Image scanning is switched off on this server (it sends package names to a public database). An administrator turns it on with ARMADOK_VULN_CHECK=true.
status.unsupported: This operating system is not covered by the database.
status.empty: No package list found in this image (it may be very minimal).
status.partial: Only the first 5000 packages were checked: the result is incomplete.
scanTip: Reads each image's package list (nothing is started) and checks versions against a public database.
